classification.difficultyReason: Locate the alternate interior sector on the opposite side of each transversal.

content.prompt: Draw an arc showing the angle alternate to $d$.

spec.description: Gently rising parallels with rightward marks left of a steep falling transversal. d is below the upper parallel and left of the transversal.
spec.mathematics: Alternate target is above the lower parallel and on the opposite side of the transversal.
spec.answerVisibility: Given label only; supplied arc hidden.

answer.short: Arc above the lower parallel, between its right arm and the northwest transversal arm.
answer.worked: The marked angle is inside the parallels and on the opposite side of the transversal from $d$ (alternate angles).

spec.description: Upper sector at lower crossing, between right parallel arm and northwest transversal arm.
Horizontal parallels with rightward marks right of a falling transversal. d lies above the lower horizontal between its east arm and the northwest transversal arm.
spec.mathematics: Alternate interior target lies below the upper horizontal, between its west arm and the southeast transversal arm.

answer.short: Arc below the upper horizontal, between its west arm and the southeast transversal arm.
answer.worked: The marked angle is inside the parallels and on the opposite side of the transversal from $d$ (alternate angles).

spec.description: Lower sector at upper crossing between west and southeast arms.
Two vertical parallels with downward marks above intersections, crossed by a gently falling transversal. d is right of the left vertical and above the transversal.
spec.mathematics: Alternate target is left of the right vertical and below the transversal.

answer.short: Arc left of the right vertical and below the transversal.
answer.worked: The marked angle is between the vertical parallels and on the opposite side of the transversal from $d$ (alternate angles).

spec.description: Right crossing between northwest transversal arm and downward vertical arm.
Two rising parallels with northeast-pointing marks above a horizontal transversal. d lies below the transversal and left of the right parallel.
spec.mathematics: Alternate target is above the transversal and right of the left parallel.
spec.answerVisibility: Given angle d is distinct from structural part label d; no answer arc.

answer.short: Arc above the horizontal, between its east arm and the left parallel's northeast arm.
answer.worked: The marked angle is inside the parallels and on the opposite side of the horizontal transversal from $d$ (alternate angles).

spec.description: Left crossing between east horizontal arm and northeast parallel arm.
